backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor implementing authorization, company settings, user profiles, and CRUD maps for clients, products, quotations, and ledger entries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping UI transparency and add‑entry‑point fixes to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of each major frontend component and page.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base styles defining theme color variables and dark mode tokens with all elements using opaque surfaces.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point loading the React app root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root component handling Internet Identity auth and showing either loading, login, or the main app shell.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Authenticated layout rendering header, company/user info, dialogs, and all primary pages with logo handling and admin controls.
frontend/src/components/billing/InvoiceP: Dialog that loads client and company settings, shows an invoice preview, and provides print and close actions.
Renders a printable invoice layout including company info, client details, and quotation line items.
frontend/src/components/clients/ClientDe: Displays client details with ledger history, balance calculations, and export options for PDF or CSV.
frontend/src/components/clients/ClientFo: Form dialog for creating or editing a client, handling input state and submit via add or update mutations.
frontend/src/components/clients/LedgerSu: Shows a summary card of total debit, total credit, and current balance values.
frontend/src/components/company/CompanyS: Dialog for editing company settings including address, GST info, and logo upload with preview.
frontend/src/components/dialogs/ConfirmD: Reusable confirmation dialog with customizable title, description, and confirm/cancel actions.
frontend/src/components/inventory/Produc: Dialog form for adding or editing a product, managing product spec fields and submitting create/update mutations.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Read-only dialog displaying full product specifications, description, details, and pricing info.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Empty file or placeholder for the profile setup dialog component.
frontend/src/components/quotations/Quota: Dialog showing detailed quotation info including client data, product specs, pricing, and a print preview trigger.
Form dialog for creating a quotation, pulling client and product data and submitting a create-quotation mutation.
Print preview dialog that loads client and company settings and renders a printable quotation view.
Renders the formatted A4-style printable layout for a quotation using client and company settings.
frontend/src/components/UserManagementDi: Admin dialog allowing role assignment by principal ID with form inputs, validation, and success/error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, handling login flow, stored identities, and auth client configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for interacting with backend data such as user profiles, settings, clients, and admin actions.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based styles, theme variables, components, and print rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/accounts/AccountsPage: Displays and updates company accounting settings, allowing admins to edit fields and save changes.
frontend/src/pages/billing/BillingPage.t: Displays approved quotations and allows creating invoices with a print preview dialog.
frontend/src/pages/clients/ClientsPage.t: Lists clients with options to add, edit, view, and delete client records.
frontend/src/pages/inventory/InventoryPa: Manages product inventory with create, edit, and delete actions and stock display.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the login UI and triggers Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/pages/products/ProductsPage: Shows a browsable product catalog with detail viewing for each product.
frontend/src/pages/quotations/Quotations: Provides quotation management including creation, viewing, and admin approval toggling.
frontend/src/utils/ledgerExport.ts: Generates printable PDF and downloadable CSV ledger reports for a client’s financial entries.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash routing) and persisting them in sessionStorage, plus utilities to clear stored or hash parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, radii, shadows, container settings, and plugins for animation, typography, and container queries.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, issues, and feature requests related to enabling disabled Add tabs and removing transparency from dialogs.
